items.title: Help Central Michigan Win the Motor City MACtion Fan Trophy!
items.summary: DETROIT, Mich.— Not only will Central Michigan and Eastern Michigan meet on the football field in next Wednesday's Motor City MACtion Game at Ford Field, but the two fan bases will compete for the rights to the game's Fan Trophy! The fan base that accumulates the most points in various categories takes home the Motor City MACtion Fan Trophy!

items.title: Motor City MACtion Game vs. Eastern Michigan Next Wednesday at Ford Field Will Kickoff at 7:30 p.m. ET
items.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, Mich.—Central Michigan's Motor City MACtion football game on Wednesday, Nov. 4 vs. Eastern Michigan is scheduled to kickoff at 7:30 p.m. ET at Ford Field in Detroit, the two schools and Mid-American Conference announced on Monday afternoon. The contest will be nationally televised on ESPN2.

items.title: Football Notebook: Glasser Shines in First Start at Quarterback
items.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, Mich. – Jadyn Glasser stepped up, admirably, at quarterback on Saturday in Central Michigan's 28-27 Mid-American Conference loss to Miami at Kelly/Shorts Stadium.
